label: Not All Thinking Is The Same
body:
Four that go somewhere

ReflectionPlanningDiscernmentProblem-solving

Three that circle

WorryRuminationObsessive thinking

label: The Main Truth
h: The difference is the fruit, not the subject.
body: You can reflect on a conversation, or ruminate on it. Plan for a meeting, or worry about it.

label: The Tool · Five Questions
body:
1. Is this producing a clear action?
  2. Am I learning anything new?
  3. Is this within my control?
  4. Have I already decided this?
  5. Is this helping me obey God today?

label: When Thinking Is Finished, Choose One
body:
ActA clear responsibility is mine now.
WaitAction may be needed, but not yet.
Seek helpI lack information, skill, safety or support.
SurrenderThe outcome does not belong to me.

What comes next is not more thought. It is one of these four.

label: Back To Daniel
h: Stopping when the thinking has done its work is not carelessness. It is trust.

label: Do This Now
h: Choose one subject your mind returned to today.
body:
Ask the five questions once. Write a yes or no beside each.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: There is a time to think, and a time to stop thinking.

label: Prayer
body:
Father, you know the questions
I keep reopening.

Show me when my thinking has done its work.

Give me courage to act, patience to wait,
humility to ask for help, and faith to let go.

Amen.
